title: ElytraLauncher
description: /el teleports you 100 blocks in the air, perfect for chill servers.
body:
This mod implements the /el (elytralauncher) command which telelports you 100 blocks in the air so you can fly around. You do not need permissions to run the command and it has a 5 second cooldown.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
